summary.text: Steve Frisbie is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 44 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a paramedic and former Calhoun County Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Steve Frisbie earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Robert B. Miller College and received his paramedic certificate from Davenport University.
His career experience includes working as a paramedic, ambulance service administrator, volunteer firefighter and adjunct professor.
Frisbie previously served as a Calhoun County Commissioner, including as chairman from 2019 to 2023.

He assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026; in the 2025-2026 session he is majority vice chair of the Financial Services Committee and also sits on the Energy, Health Policy and Transportation committees.
